description: Lists this workspace’s campaigns, newest first, one page at a time: each one’s id, state (draft, scheduled, sending, paused, sent or stopped), number, template, saved audience, time, quiet hours, and how many it was for, sent, delivered, read, got a reply from and failed for. These are the campaigns on the Campaigns page of the Cosend dashboard. Read-only.

after.description: The next_cursor of the previous page, to read the page after it. Omit for the first page.

connection_id.description: Only campaigns on this WhatsApp number. Repeat for several.

items.description: Only campaigns on this WhatsApp number. Repeat for several.

limit.description: How many records to return. Defaults to 25, maximum 100.

q.description: Only campaigns whose name contains this.

status.description: Only campaigns in this state, e.g. draft or sending. Repeat for several.

items.description: Only campaigns in this state, e.g. draft or sending. Repeat for several.

name: list_campaigns
title: List campaigns
